01 / About

MORE THAN A COACH.
A BUILDER OF ATHLETES.

Rahul S is a Boxing, Kickboxing and Wushu Coach with more than five years of coaching experience and over two years as a certified fitness trainer. He has trained more than 1,000 athletes and helped develop players for national and international-level competition.

As Kerala Team Assistant Coach with the Kerala State Amateur Kickboxing Association, Rahul supports athlete preparation, technical development and competition readiness. His approach combines discipline, strength conditioning and a commitment to long-term athlete growth.

His coaching philosophy is simple: build the fundamentals, respect the process and bring purpose to every round.
